title: Текущие owners и snapshot baseline
integration_rule: One repo/owner audit reused across the product.

title: Evidence graph
integration_rule: One goal/code/test/result graph; UI/report consumers reuse it.

title: AI handoff и missing context
integration_rule: One ContextPack/AIResult boundary and source references.

title: Secrets и egress
integration_rule: One secrets-reference and egress policy owner.

title: Снимок и устаревание
integration_rule: Common version binding; domain-specific invalidation rules.

title: Капсулы неудач
integration_rule: One failure record model; different retrieval contexts.

title: Capability catalog
integration_rule: Bot entries are domain capabilities under the common registry.

title: Durable jobs
integration_rule: Reuse job/checkpoint owner for schedules and campaigns.

title: Параллелизм и конфликты
integration_rule: Resource-specific coordination; no global single-worker rule.

title: Цена результата
integration_rule: Record total attempt cost, including losing branches.

title: Обновления и восстановление
integration_rule: Shared migration/backup primitives; later automated release activation.

title: Происхождение доказательств
integration_rule: Shared provenance graph; source independence is assessed per claim.

title: Media ingestion
integration_rule: One source/extraction pipeline feeds product and research views.

title: История разработки
integration_rule: One revision-aware PR/CI source index; no duplicate importer.

title: Сохранность целей
integration_rule: Shared open-loop graph and evidence-linked continuation output.
